summary: First connected public-alpha mathematics atlas with measurable breadth decomposition and a mobile-first viewer.
changes: Established one connected mathematics root, 13 regions, and 85 territories.
Decomposed every territory past the measurable v1 breadth floor.
Replaced repeated generic capability-family definitions with 233 distinct, territory-scoped summaries of their bounded child performances.
Added typed concepts, knowledge, representations, practices, capabilities, composites, and relationship claims.
Added deterministic compilation, semantic and schema validation, query tools, downstream conformance fixtures, and a responsive viewer.
Kept all AI-assisted mathematical records and claims at candidate status pending accountable review.
known_limitations: All mathematical records and relationships are candidates; structural validation is not expert acceptance.
Most dependency declarations remain unreviewed and the current graph contains only a pressure-test set of requires claims.
Coverage breadth is machine-audited, but qualitative scope, granularity, duplication, and correctness review remains open.
The release is an alpha format and is not Open Learning Atlas: Mathematics v1.0.
